_about: How often things happen. Minutes are café minutes [shortest, longest]; the game picks a time in between at random.
moment_minutes: a cat coming to you with a moment (always with choices; it waits for your answer). Most choices are in Look around (Esc menu).
retry_minutes: when no moment fits right now (no cat in the room, say), look again this much later.
quiet_after_minutes: small talk waits at least this long after anything else has been said.
question_seconds: real seconds a narrator question ("Something to drink?") waits before taking its quiet answer. Cat moments always wait.
cup_kept_minutes: come back within this many minutes and your drink is still on the table.
favourite_after_orders: a drink becomes your favourite once you've ordered it this many times (and more than any other).
autosave_seconds: how often the café saves while you're inside (it also saves when you leave).

Settings (Esc menu, Settings): quiet_factor stretches the waits for moments and small talk in quiet mode (2 = half as often); very_slow_factor does the same for the "Very slow" pacing (1.5 = moments every 15–30 minutes). Both together multiply.
letters_per_second: how fast words type out at each text speed (Instant shows each page at once).
